description: This Java source file defines the JwtAuthenticationProvider class, which handles JWT-based authentication within the security framework of the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for verifying JWT tokens extracted from HTTP request headers, validating tokens, and producing authentication results, implementing a thread-unsafe singleton pattern with controlled instantiation.

classes.name: JwtAuthenticationProvider
classes.description: A thread-unsafe final class responsible for authenticating HTTP requests using JWT tokens. It handles extraction, validation, and result creation for JWT-based authentication, integrating with the application's security context.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a new JwtAuthenticationProvider with specified JWT validation and result provider dependencies.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Checks whether the incoming request contains an Authorization header starting with 'Bearer', indicating a JWT for authentication.

methods.name: tryToAuthenticate
methods.description: Main authentication method that extracts JWT from the request, validates it, and produces an AuthenticationResult, handling missing or invalid tokens appropriately.

methods.name: extractJwtFromRequest
methods.description: Extracts an ImmutableJsonWebToken from the request's Authorization header if present.

methods.name: buildMissingJwtException
methods.description: Creates a DittoRuntimeException indicating a missing JWT in the request.

methods.name: getAuthenticationResult
methods.description: Validates the JWT token and constructs an AuthenticationResult if valid, or throws an exception upon failure.

methods.name: buildJwtUnauthorizedException
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating the JWT could not be verified.

methods.name: tryToGetAuthenticationResult
methods.description: Gets AuthenticationResult from the JwtAuthenticationResultProvider, catching exceptions and converting them to unauthorized exceptions.

methods.name: toFailedAuthenticationResult
methods.description: Returns a failed AuthenticationResult with details about the failure, used when JWT authentication fails.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the authorization context type associated with JWT.
